items.q: Which POS systems do you support?
items.a: Syrve today, with Foodics on the roadmap. Reservations come in from SevenRooms, and targets and reference data from Google Sheets.

It depends on your POS and the number of locations. Your manager will give you a timeline after the demo. Standard onboarding is included with annual billing: one supported connection, user access set-up and a kick-off session.
Only the people you give access to. Access is set by role and location: a venue manager sees their venue, the owner sees every venue.

items.q: Can we start with some locations or some blocks?
items.a: Yes. Core is required for each location on VILAX; blocks are added only where you need them.

items.q: Does VILAX work for a single venue?
items.a: Yes. Pricing is per location, starting from one.
Monthly, or annually in advance with 10% off the subscription and standard onboarding included. Prices exclude VAT; VAT at 5% is added on top.
AI usage is included in the subscription: the Coordinator handles 500 requests per location per month. If you need more, add a pack for the rest of the month, with no automatic charges.
No separate app is needed: VILAX runs in the browser on desktop and mobile, and daily summaries arrive in Telegram.
